name: Cannabis Coconut Oil
desc: Cannabis decarboxylated in the oven, then infused into coconut oil with lecithin; adults only.

source.evidence: Searched cannabis coconut oil recipes with oven decarboxylation and soy lecithin (Wake + Bake, Verilife, Veriheal); none matches this Pyrex, oven bag and candy thermometer method closely enough to claim.

ingredients.raw: 7 g dried cannabis flower (or 3 g hash)
1/4 to 1/2 cup coconut oil, melted (use less for a more concentrated oil)
ingredients.note: use less for a more concentrated oil

ingredients.raw: Equipment: an oven-safe glass (Pyrex) baking dish, foil or an oven bag, a candy thermometer, cheesecloth, and a wide-mouth jar for storage

steps: Preheat the oven to 220°F. Break up or coarsely grind the cannabis.

Decarboxylate first; this is what activates the THC. Spread the ground flower in the glass dish no more than 1/2 to 3/4 inch deep so the heat reaches all of it. Use more than one dish for larger amounts.
If using hash, break it into small chunks and scatter it evenly. For concentrates, warm the empty dish in the oven for a few minutes first, then spread the extract thin.
Cover the dish tightly with foil or seal it in an oven bag and bake 20 to 30 minutes. Older, drier herb needs 15 to 20 minutes; a freshly dried crop needs 30 to 45.
Meanwhile, warm the coconut oil in a small saucepan over low heat until it reads about 200°F on the candy thermometer.
Uncover the dish, pour the hot oil over the decarboxylated material, and stir in the lecithin. Reseal and return to the oven, lowered to 200°F, for 1 to 2 hours, stirring every 30 minutes.

Line a strainer with a double layer of cheesecloth set over the jar. Pour the oil through and, once cool enough to handle, squeeze the cloth to get the rest out. Cover and store somewhere cool and dark.
tips: Potency varies a lot batch to batch. Start with a very small amount, such as 1/4 tsp, and wait a full 2 hours before taking any more.
Label the jar clearly and keep it away from children and pets.
Stovetop alternative: infuse in a double boiler over barely simmering water, keeping the oil between 160°F and 200°F for about 2 hours.

references.title: Cannabis Coconut Oil
references.usedFor: strain through layered cheesecloth and squeeze once cool; 160 to 180°F low-heat infusion range for the stovetop tip
